hits.title: Nozomi Networks and Sophos unite IT and OT security operations through new Sophos Fusion integration.
hits.snippet: This integration brings Nozomi's OT telemetry, asset intelligence, and threat data directly into Sophos Fusion, where it can be correlated with security data from across the customer's IT environment without needing to switch contexts, putting OT intelligence directly where investigations happen to help security teams work faster and make better decisions.

hits.title: Anthropic and Nozomi bring AI vulnerability research to OT security.
hits.snippet: Nozomi Networks has joined Anthropic's Project Glasswing, an initiative using artificial intelligence to identify software vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure and connected systems.

hits.title: Bastazo and Nozomi Networks team up to deliver advanced cyber security solutions to OT & IoT environments.
hits.snippet: BENTONVILLE, Ark., July 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - Bastazo, the AI-powered OT remediation platform and Nozomi Networks Inc., the leader in AI-powered OT, IoT and CPS security today announced a technology integration that transforms how critical infrastructure operators respond to cyber threats.

hits.title: Dragos, UAE Cyber Security Council launch OT cybersecurity Centre of Excellence to strengthen industrial resilience.
hits.snippet: Earlier this month, the UAE Cybersecurity Council and Nozomi Networks announced a collaboration aimed at strengthening the cybersecurity resilience of the UAE's critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

hits.snippet: Abu Dhabi, May 5 / WAM / The Cybersecurity Council announced a joint strategic collaboration with Nozomi Networks, a global leader in operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) security, aimed at enhancing the cybersecurity resilience of critical infrastructure and industrial sectors in the country.

hits.title: Infinigate UK&I and Nozomi Networks announce strategic partnership.
hits.snippet: London, UK - 14 April 2026 - Infinigate UK&I, the specialist distributor and trusted advisor in cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure and Nozomi Networks, the leader in OT, IoT and CPS security, are announcing a strategic partnership across the UK&I, bringing unparalleled visibility, proactive threat detection and enhanced resilience for critical infrastructure to channel partners in the region.

hits.title: Nozomi Networks named recognised in the 2026 Gartner Critical Capabilities report for CPS Protection Platforms.
hits.snippet: In addition to being recognised as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant, Nozomi Networks is the only vendor in the category to be recognised as a Customers' Choice in Gartner's most recent Voice of the Customer report for CPS Protection Platforms.
